title: One Room: Second Season -extra-
justification: AniList 107298 has 1 episode (2018-11-30, 12 min; 'One Room: Second Season -extra-'). TVDB 319995 0x03 'Second Season Special' is dated 2018-11-30; 0x01 'OVA' (2017-05-26) belongs to AniDB 12550. The overlay entry for 13480 already moves S1 to 0x03 by hand review. Titles agree by meaning (Second Season special / extra) and date.
